title: 第15章 寿布战旗第16章 云霞宗弟子出手
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第15章寿布战旗
不远处茶馆二楼，
雅间中，
江峰正陪同一位年轻公子喝茶，
“林公子，这青竹茶是我们天武城的特产，虽不甚名贵，但也别有一番风味。”
“不错，你们天武城这种穷乡僻壤，没想到还有这般好茶。”
林寒的嚣张傲慢江峰却毫不在乎，姿态更加恭敬，
“您喜欢就好，临行前我为您准备一些，您带回去。”
“茶水倒是其次，那个小少妇，你们父子安排的怎么样了。”
江峰眯着眼睛，将窗帘拉开，
“林公子，您请看...”
林寒站起身来，看着楼下不远处的骚乱，
一道魅惑的倩影出现在他的视线中，
虽只是远远一瞥，
但那如山川起伏般的曲线已经深深印在了他的心中，
林寒嘴巴大张，整个人都已经呆住，死死的盯住那个风姿绰约的身影，那妖娆体态简直难以形容，长裙下，隐约暴露出那双圆润修长的美腿，
散发着无与伦比的魅力，容貌虽非绝色，可那股娇媚性感却远非寻常绝色可比，
加上那双勾魂摄魄的杏瞳，释放出一股无与伦比的勾人气息，纵使阅女无数，这女人也是他所见过的前三之数！
“那个女人！”
林寒神色惊喜，声音都有些颤抖，

“极品，极品啊！”
江峰看到林寒激动兴奋的表情，便知道自己目的达到了，
“这就是小人为您准备的绝色佳人，她叫宫婉，并非天武城人士，乃是岭南逃荒而来，因为一些原因，前段时间嫁给了本家的一个后生，不过林公子有所不知，这小子二十岁了，却还是铸体境界，您说，就这种废物，
有什么资格拥有这么漂亮的媳妇？”
“难怪如此有味道，铸体武者的媳妇...江峰，你有心了，若是此事办成，你就跟在我身边吧。”
林寒的嘴角，却是泛起一抹淫荡笑容，人妻，玩起来才有意思嘛，
江峰两眼猛地睁大，激动的无以复加，半晌才反应过来，扑通跪在林寒面前，
“江峰谢林公子大恩，若能跟在林公子身畔，小人一定殚精竭虑，全心全意伺候林公子！”
江峰原本只是想一箭双雕，既能驱逐江尘，又能交好林寒，
没想到竟然能遇到这种一步登天的好事，要知道，小小的江家和云霞宗弟子是两个完全不同的概念，若是自己能进入云霞宗，哪怕只是外门弟子，也足够江家光宗耀祖，一飞冲天了！
.....
“江尘，你为了不被赶出江家，怎么...怎么能娶个肺痨鬼进来呢！
你是我们看着长大的，
即使你一直不能凝气成功，我们也把你当做自己子侄看待，将这女人送出城吧，
我们不会去官府告发你的！”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Shoubu Battle Flag
Not far away, on the second floor of the teahouse,
In the elegant room,
Jiang Feng was drinking tea with a young gentleman.
"Mr. Lin, this green bamboo tea is a specialty of our Tianwu City. Although it is not very expensive, it has a unique flavor."
"Yes, I didn't expect such a good tea in a remote place like your Tianwu City."
Jiang Feng didn't care about Lin Han's arrogance and arrogance, and his attitude became more respectful.
"As long as you like it. I'll prepare some for you before leaving. You can take it back."
"Tea is the next best thing. That young lady, how are your father and son's arrangements going?"
Jiang Feng squinted his eyes and opened the curtains.
"Mr. Lin, please take a look..."
Lin Han stood up and looked at the commotion not far downstairs.
A charming figure appeared in his sight,
Although it's just a glimpse from a distance,
But the curves like the undulating mountains and rivers have been deeply imprinted in his heart.
Lin Han's mouth opened wide, and he was stunned, staring at the graceful figure. The voluptuous figure was simply indescribable. Under the long skirt, a pair of round and slender legs were vaguely exposed.
She exudes unparalleled charm. Although her appearance is not stunning, her charm and sexiness are far from ordinary and stunning.
Coupled with those captivating almond eyes, they released an unparalleled alluring aura. Even though he had seen countless women, this woman was one of the top three he had ever seen!
"That woman!"
Lin Han looked surprised and his voice was trembling.
"Excellent, excellent!"
When Jiang Feng saw Lin Han's excited expression, he knew that he had achieved his goal.
"This is the stunning beauty that I have prepared for you. Her name is Gong Wan. She is not from Tianwu City, but came from Lingnan. For some reasons, she married a young man from my family some time ago. However, Mr. Lin does not know. This kid is twenty years old, but he is still in the realm of cast body. You said, this kind of waste,
What qualifications do you have to have such a beautiful wife? "
"No wonder it's so delicious. The daughter-in-law of a body-casting warrior...Jiang Feng, you have your heart. If this is done, you can stay with me."
A lustful smile appeared on the corner of Lin Han's mouth. Married women are only fun to play with.
Jiang Feng's eyes widened suddenly, and he was extremely excited. It took him a while to react, and he knelt down in front of Lin Han.
"Jiang Feng thanks Mr. Lin for his great kindness. If I can stay by Mr. Lin's side, I will work hard and serve Mr. Lin wholeheartedly!"
Jiang Feng originally just wanted to kill two birds with one stone, to expel Jiang Chen and make friends with Lin Han.
I didn’t expect to encounter such a good thing that could reach the sky in one step. You must know that the disciples of the small Jiang family and the Yunxia Sect are two completely different concepts. If I can enter the Yunxia Sect, even if I am only an outer disciple, it will be enough for the Jiang family to become a proud ancestor and soar to the sky!
.....
"Jiang Chen, in order to avoid being kicked out of the Jiang family, how...how could you marry a consumptive ghost and come in!
We watched you grow up,
Even if you never succeed in condensing energy, we will treat you as our nephew and send this woman out of the city.
We will not report you to the government! "
